spans.s:
उत 1. उत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वे), sewn,
woven.

उत 2. उत, ind. (as a particle of doubt or
deliberation) and, also, even, or. Often used for the
sake of emphasis, especially at the end of a line after
इति or a verb (e. g. सर्व-भूतानि तम् पार्थ सदा
परिभवन्त्य् उत, all creatures, O king, certainly
always despise him).
(As an interrogative particle, generally at the begin-
ning of the second or following part of a double in-
terrogation) or, utrum-an (e. g. कथम् निर्णीयते
किं स्यान् निष्कारणो बन्धुर् उत विश्वास-घा-
[]
तकः, how can it be decided whether he be a friend
without a motive or a violator of confidence ?). In
this sense it may be strengthened by आहो (e. g. कच्चित्
त्वम् असि मानुषी उताहो सुराङ्गना, art thou a
mortal woman or divine ?), or by आहो-स्वित् (e. g.
शालिहोत्रः किं नु स्याद् उताहोस्विद् राजा नलः,
can it be Śālihotra or king Nala ?). Rarely किम् is
repeated before उत used in this sense (e. g. किं नु
स्वर्गात् प्राप्ता तस्या रूपेण किमुत अन्या आगता,
has she arrived from heaven or has another come in
her form ?).
(As a particle of wishing, especially at the beginning
of a sentence followed by a potential) would that!
utinam! (e. g. उत अधीयीत, would that he would
read!).
(उत preceded by किम्) on the contrary, how
much more, how much less (e. g. समर्थो ऽसि स-
हस्रम् अपि जेतुं किमुत एकम्, thou art able to
conquer even a thousand, how much more one ?).
(उत preceded by प्रति) on the contrary, rather
(e. g. एष पृष्टो ऽस्माभिर् न जल्पति हन्ति
प्रत्युत पाषाणैः, this one questioned by us does
not speak, but rather throws stones at us). उत वा,
or else, and (e. g. समुद्राद् उत वा पुरीषात्, from
the sea or from the moisture in the air); वा-उत
वा or उताहो वापि-वा, either — or; उत-उत, both —
and (e. g. उत बलवान् उत अबलः, both the strong
and the weak); किम्-उत वा, whether — or else.
उत, अस्, आ, अम्, woven. See s. v., p. 147.

उत्त उत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, wet, moistened. See
2. उद्, page 153.

1. ऊत, अस्, आ, अम्, favoured, preserved, promoted,
loved.
ऊत 2. ऊत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वे), woven.
ऊत, ऊति. See s. v., p. 177.

उतङ्क उतङ्क, अस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi.
—उतङ्क-मेघ, अस्, m. a kind of cloud named
after that Ṛṣi.

उतथ्य उतथ्य, अस्, m., N. of a son of
Aṅgiras and elder brother of Bṛhaspati.
—उतथ्य-
तनय, अस्, m. an epithet of Gautama.
—उतथ्या-
नुज, अस्, m. or उतथ्यानुजन्मन् (˚य-अनु-ज˚),
आ, m. a N. of Bṛhaspati, regent of the planet Jupiter
(younger brother of Utathya).

उताहो उताहो, ind. (fr. 2. उत + आहो), a par-
ticle of doubt or deliberation = either, or; see under
2. उत above.
—उताहो-स्वित्, see under 2. उत.

उत्तंस उत्-तंस, अस्, अम्, m. n. (rt. तंस्), an
earring; a crest, a chaplet, a wreath worn on the
crown of the head.
उत्तंसिक, अस्, m., N. of a Nāga.
उत्तंसित, अस्, आ, अम्, having earrings, crested.

उत्तक्ष् उत्-तक्ष् (उद्-त्˚), cl. 1. 5. P., Ved.
-तक्षति, -क्ष्णोति, -क्षितुम् or -तष्टुम्, to form
(anything) out of any other thing; (Sāy.) to take
(anything) out of any other thing.

उत्तङ्ग उत्तङ्ग, अस्, m., N. of a servant of
Śiva.

उत्तट उत्-तट, अस्, आ, अम्, overflowing its
banks (as a river).

उत्तन् उत्-तन् (उद्-त्˚), cl. 8. P. A. -तनोति,
-नुते, -नितुम्, to stretch upwards, stretch out; en-
deavour to rise.

उत्-तान, अस्, आ, अम्, stretched out, spread out,
lying on the back, sleeping supinely or with the face
upwards; upright; turned so that the mouth or
opening is uppermost (as a vessel), concave; spread-
ing out over the surface; shallow; open.
—उत्तान-
कूर्मक, अम्, n. a particular posture in sitting.
—उत्-
तान-पत्त्रक, अस्, m. a species of Ricinus.
—उत्-
तान-पद्, f., Ved. one whose legs are extended (in
parturition or creation); epithet of a peculiar creative
agency described in Ṛg-veda

; (Sāy.) vegetation,
the whole creation of upward-germinating plants.
—उत्-
तान-पर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having extended leaves.
—उत्तान-पाद, अस्, m. the star ß in the little bear,
personified as son of Vīra or Manu Svāyambhuva and
father of Dhruva, the polar-star.
—उत्तानपाद-ज,
अस्, m. a N. of Dhruva or the polar-star.
—उत्तान-
बर्हिस्, इस्, m., N. of a prince.
—उत्तान-शय, अस्,
[]
आ, अम्, lying on the back, sleeping with the face up-
wards; (अस्, आ), m. f. a little child.
—उत्तान-शीवन्,
आ, अरी, अ, Ved. lying extended, stagnant.
—उत्तान-
हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having the hands extended,
extending them in prayer; (औ), m. du. the two
hands with the fingers stretched out, but with the
backs towards the ground.
उत्तान उत्-तान. See under उत्-तन्, p. 149.
उत्तानक, अस्, m. a species of Cyperus grass.
उत्तानिका, f., N. of a river.

उत्तप् उत्-तप् (उद्-त्˚), cl. 1. P. rarely A.
-तपति, -ते, -प्तुम्, to make warm or hot, to heat
thoroughly; to pain, torment; to excite, urge on,
press hard: Caus. P. -तापयति, -यितुम्, to warm
up, heat.

उत्-तप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, burnt, seared; bathed, washed;
anxious, excited; (अम्), n. dried flesh.

उत्-ताप, अस्, m. great heat, affliction, distress,
anxiety, excitement, ardour, effort, energy.
उत्ताप उत्-ताप. See under उत्-तप्, p. 149.

उत्-तापित, अस्, आ, अम्, heated, made hot, pained,
distressed, roused, excited.

उत्तम् उत्-तम् (उद्-त्˚), cl. 4. P. -ताम्यति,
-तमितुम्, to be distressed, to lose heart, to faint.

उत्तम उत्-तम, अस्, आ, अम् (superlative fr. 1. उद्;
opposed to अवम, अधम, &c.; cf. अन्-उत्तम),
uppermost, highest, chief; most elevated, principal;
best, excellent (often at the end of compounds, e. g.
द्विजोत्तमस्, best of the twice-born); first, greatest;
the highest (tone); the most removed or last in place,
order, or time; (अम्), ind. most, in the highest de-
gree; (अस्), m. the last person (= in European gram-
mars the first person); N. of a brother of Dhruva,
son of Uttāna-pāda and nephew of Priya-vrata; a
son of Priya-vrata and third Manu; the twenty-first
Vyāsa; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (आ), f. a kind
of piḍakā or pustule; the plant Oxystelma Esculentum
(Asclepias Rosea Roxb.); an excellent woman, one
who is handsome, healthy, and affectionate.
—उत्-
तम-गन्धाढ्य (˚ध-आढ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, pos-
sessing abundantly the most delicate scent or delicious
fragrance.
—उत्तम-ता, f. or उत्तम-त्व, अम्, n.
excellence, superiority; goodness, good quality.
—उत्-
तम-पद, अम्, n. a high office.
—उत्तम-पुरु-
ष or उत्तम-पूरुष, अस्, m. the last person in
verbal conjugation, i. e. I, we two, we (= in European
grammars the first person, our third person being re-
garded in Hindū grammars as the प्रथम-पुरुष,
q. v.; cf. also मध्यम-पुरुष); the supreme
spirit; an excellent man.
—उत्तम-फलिनी, f. the
plant Oxystelma Esculentum (Asclepias Rosea Roxb.).
—उत्तमर्ण (˚म-ऋण), अस्, m. a creditor; (आस्),
m. pl., N. of a people.
—उत्तमर्णिक, अस्, m. a
creditor.
—उत्तमर्णिन्, ई, m. a creditor.
—उत्तम-
लाभ, अस्, m. great profit, a double return.
—उत्-
तम-वेश, अस्, m. ‘having the most excellent dress,’
N. of Śiva.
—उत्तम-शाख, अस्, m., N. of a region.
—उत्तम-सङ्ग्रह, अस्, m. intriguing with another
man's wife, addressing her privately, casting amorous
looks &c.
—उत्तम-साहस, अम्, n. the highest of
the three fixed mulcts or fines; a fine of 1000 or of
80,000 paṇas; capital punishment, branding, banish-
ment, confiscation, mutilation, and death.
—उत्तम-
सुख, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—उत्तमाङ्ग (˚म-
अङ्˚), अम्, n. the highest or chief part of the body,
the head.
—उत्तमाधम (˚म-अध्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
high and low.
—उत्तमाधम-मध्यम, अस्, आ,
अम्, good, bad, and indifferent; high, low, and
middling.
—उत्तमारणी (˚म-अर्˚), f. the plant As-
paragus Racemosus.
—उत्तमार्ध (˚म-अर्˚), अस्, m.
the last half or part; the best half.
—उत्तमार्ध्य,
अस्, आ, अम्, relating to or connected with the last part
or the best half.
—उत्तमाह (˚म-अह्˚), अस्, m. the
last or latest day, a fine day (?), a lucky day (?).
—उत्-
तमोपपद (˚म-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, one to whom
the best term is applicable, best, good.
—उत्तमौजस्
(˚म-ओज्˚), आस्, m. ‘of excellent valour,’ N. of one of
the warriors of the Mahā-bhārata.

उत्तमाय्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fut. pass. part. fr. a nom.
उत्तमाय ?), Ved. to be raised or celebrated.

उत्तमीय, अस्, आ, अम्, uppermost, highest, chief,
best.

1. उत्-तर, अस्, आ, अम् (comparative fr. 1. उद्; opposed
to अधर; declined
Gram. 238

. a), upper, higher,
superior (e. g. उत्तरे दन्तास्, the upper teeth);
northern (because the northern part of India is high);
left (opposed to दक्षिण or right, because in pray-
ing the face being turned to the east the north would
be on the left-hand); later, following, subsequent,
latter, concluding, posterior, future (opposed to पूर्व,
&c., e. g. उत्तरः कालः, future time; उत्तरं
वाक्यम्, a following speech, answer, reply; फलम्
उत्तरम्, subsequent result, future consequence;
वर्षोत्तरेषु, in future years); superior, chief,
excellent, dominant, predominant, more powerful;
better, more excellent; (अस्), m., N. of a son of
Virāṭa; a king of the Nāgas; N. of a mountain;
(आ), f. the north (i. e. the northern दिश् or quarter);
N. of a daughter of Virāṭa and daughter-in-law of
Arjuna; (अम्), n. upper surface or cover; the north;
the following member, the last part of a compound;
answer, reply; (in law) a defence, a rejoinder; (in
the Mimāṃsā philosophy) the answer, the fourth
member of an adhikaraṇa or case; superiority, ex-
cellence, competency; result, the chief or prevalent
result or characteristic, what remains or is left, con-
clusion, remainder, excess, over and above, (often
at the end of a compound, e. g. षष्ट्युत्तरं
सहस्रम्, one thousand with an excess of sixty, i. e.
1060; सप्तोत्तरं शतम्, 107; भयोत्तर, at-
tended with danger, having danger as the result;
धर्मोत्तर, chiefly characterized by virtue); re-
mainder, difference (in arithmetic); N. of a song;
(अम्), ind. at the conclusion, at the end, e. g. भवद्-
उत्तरम्, with the word ‘bhavad’ at the end; अस्रोत्-
तरम् ईक्षिता, looked at with tears at the end, i. e.
with a glance ending in tears; [cf. Gr. ὕστερος.]
—उत्तर-काण्ड, अम्, n. following or concluding
book; the seventh book of the Rāmāyaṇa.
—उत्तर-
काय, अस्, m. the upper part of the body.
—उत्तर-
काल, अस्, m. future time; time reckoned from full
moon to full moon.
—उत्तर-कुरु, उस् or उ, m. n. one
of the nine divisions of the world, the country of the
northern Kurus, situated in the north of India, and
described as the country of eternal beatitude.
—उत्-
तर-कोशला, f. the city Ayodhyā, the modern Oude.
—उत्तर-क्रिया, f. the last sacred action, funeral
rites, obsequies.
—उत्तर-खण्ड, अम्, n. last section;
the concluding book of the Padma-purāṇa, also of the
Śiva-purāṇa.
—उत्तर-खण्डन, अम्, n. cutting off
a reply, refutation.
—उत्तर-ग्रन्थ, अस्, m. title of
a supplement of the Yoni-grantha.
—१. उत्तरङ्-ग,
अम्, n. a wooden arch surmounting the door frame.
—उत्तर-च्छद, अस्, m. a cover, what is thrown
over anything.
—उत्तर-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, born in the
latter (or last-mentioned kind of wedlock); born
subsequently or afterwards, posterity.
—उत्तर-ज्या,
f. the versed sine of an arc, or rather the second half
of the chord halved by the versed sine.
—उत्तर-
ज्योतिष, अम्, n., N. of a country.
—उत्तर-तन्त्र,
अम्, n. ‘concluding doctrine,’ N. of a supplementary
section in the medical manual of Suśruta.
—उत्तर-
तर, अस्, आ, अम् (compar. fr. उत्तर), still further
removed, still more distant, still higher.
—उत्तर-
तस्, ind. at the top, above, from the north, north-
ward, to the left (opposed to दक्षिण-तस्); after-
wards; behind.
—उत्तरतः-पश्चात्, ind. north-
westward (with gen.).
—उत्तर-तापनीय, title of
the second part of the Nṛsiṃha-tāpanīyopaniṣad.
—उत्तर-त्र, ind. in what follows, after, subse-
quently, later, further on, beyond, below (in a work),
northward; (पूर्वत्र उत्तरत्र, in the first case or
place — in the second.)
—उत्तर-दायक, अस्, आ, अम्,
replying, giving an answer, impertinent.
—उत्तरदिक्-
स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, situated in the north, northern.
—उत्तर-दिश्, क्, f. the north quarter.
—उत्तर-
देश, अस्, m. the country towards the north, the up-
country.
—उत्तर-धेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be done
subsequently.
—उत्तर-पक्ष, अस्, m. the northern
or left wing (side); second or following part of an
argument, the reason प्रो, the reply, refutation;
[]
the answer to the first or objectionable argument, the
right argument, demonstrated truth, or conclusion; the
minor proposition in a syllogism.
—उत्तरपक्ष-
ता, f. or उत्तरपक्ष-त्व, अम्, n. conclusion, de-
monstration, reply.
—उत्तर-पट, अस्, m. an upper
garment.
—उत्तर-पथ, अस्, m. the northern way,
the way leading to the north.
—उत्तरपथिक,
अस्, ई, अम्, inhabiting the northern country.
—उत्-
तर-पद, अम्, n. the last member of a com-
pound word.
—उत्तरपदिक, अस्, ई, अम्, or उत्तर-
पदकीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to or studying the
last word or term.
—उत्तर-पर्वत, अस्, m. the
northern mountain.
—उत्तर-पश्चार्ध (˚च-अर्˚),
अस्, m. the north-western half.
—उत्तर-पश्चिम,
अस्, आ, अम्, north-western; (आ), f. the north-west
(scil. दिश्).
—उत्तर-पाद, अस्, m. a division of legal
practice, that part which relates to the reply or de-
fence, four divisions being admitted in every suit.
—उत्तर-पुरस्तात्, ind. north-eastward (with gen.).
—उत्तर-पुरुष, अस्, m. = उत्तम-पुरुष (?).
—उत्तर-पूर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, north-eastward; one who
takes the north for the east.
—उत्तर-प्रच्छद,
अस्, m. a coverlid, a quilt.
—उत्तर-प्रत्युत्तर,
अम्, n. a dispute, an altercation, a discussion; the
pleadings in a law-suit.
—उत्तर-फल्गुनी or उत्त-
र-फाल्गुनी, f. the twelfth lunar mansion, containing
two stars, figured by a bed.
—उत्तर-भाद्रपद्, त्,
f. or उत्तर-भाद्रपदा, f. the twenty-sixth lunar
mansion, figured by a couch, and comprehending two
stars, of which one is अ Andromedæ.
—उत्तर-मति,
इस्, m., N. of a man.
—उत्तर-मन्द्रा, f. a loud but
slow manner of singing.
—उत्तर-मात्र, अम्, n. a
mere reply, even a reply.
—उत्तर-मानस, अम्, n.,
N. of a Tīrtha.
—उत्तर-मीमांसा, f. the Vedānta
philosophy, an inquiry into the Jñāna-kāṇḍa or second
portion of the Veda (opposed to पूर्व-मीमांसा;
see मीमांसा).
—उत्तर-रहित, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid
of reply, having no answer.
—उत्तर-राम-चरित or
-चरित्र, अम्, n. ‘the further or later deeds of Rāma,’
title of a drama of Bhavabhūti.
—उत्तर-लक्षण,
अम्, n. the indication of an actual reply; (अस्, आ, अम्),
marked on the left side.
—उत्तर-लोमन्, आ, आ, अ,
having the hairs turned upwards or outwards.
—उत्तर-
वयस, अम्, n. the latter or declining years of life.
—उत्तर-वल्ली, f. title of the second section of the
Kāṭhakopaniṣad when divided into two Adhyāyas.
—उत्तर-वस्ति, इस्, f. a small syringe, a urethra
injection pipe.
—उत्तर-वस्त्र, अम्, n. an upper
garment.
—उत्तर-वादिन्, ई, m. a replicant; a de-
fendant; one whose claims are of later date than
another's.
—उत्तर-वासस्, अस्, n. an upper garment.
—उत्तर-वेदि, इस् or ई, f., Ved. the northern altar
made for the sacred fire.
—उत्तर-सक्थ, अम्, n.
the left thigh.
—उत्तर-सञ्ज्ञित, अस्, आ, अम्, desig-
nated in the reply (a witness &c.); hear-say evidence,
see the next.
—उत्तर-साक्षिन्, ई, m. witness for the
defence; a witness testifying from the report of others.
—उत्तर-साधक, अस्, आ, अम्, finishing what re-
mains or follows, assisting at a ceremony, befriending;
an assistant, a helper, a friend; who or what establishes
a reply.
—उत्तर-हनु, उस्, m., Ved. the upper jaw-
bone.
—उत्तराधर (˚र-अध्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, superior
and inferior, higher and lower; (अम्), n. the upper
and under lip; the lips; see अधरोत्तर.
—उत्तरा-
